---
title: "OU Simulation With Fitted Censoring"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    df_print: paged
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
})

AUDIT_DIR <- if (dir.exists("artifacts")) {
  "."
} else {
  "analyses/K00_GemcitabineExposure_033023/dev/censoring_audit"
}

MODELS_RDS <- file.path(AUDIT_DIR, "artifacts/censoring_models.rds")
SIMULATION_RDS <- file.path(AUDIT_DIR, "artifacts/ou_censoring_simulation.rds")

if (!file.exists(MODELS_RDS)) {
  stop("Missing censoring model artifact: ", MODELS_RDS, call. = FALSE)
}
if (!file.exists(SIMULATION_RDS)) {
  stop("Missing simulation artifact: ", SIMULATION_RDS, call. = FALSE)
}

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12))

source_order <- c("Observed", "OU uncensored", "OU + context censoring", "OU + full censoring")
source_palette <- c(
  "Observed" = "black",
  "OU uncensored" = "#1b9e77",
  "OU + context censoring" = "#7570b3",
  "OU + full censoring" = "#d95f02"
)
```

```{r load-artifacts}
censoring_artifact <- readRDS(MODELS_RDS)
simulation <- readRDS(SIMULATION_RDS)

metrics <- simulation$metrics
tracks <- simulation$simulated_tracks |>
  mutate(source = factor(.data$source, levels = source_order))

msd <- metrics$msd |>
  mutate(source = factor(.data$source, levels = source_order))
velocity_autocorrelation <- metrics$velocity_autocorrelation |>
  mutate(source = factor(.data$source, levels = source_order))
track_lengths <- metrics$track_lengths |>
  mutate(source = factor(.data$source, levels = source_order))
speeds <- metrics$speeds |>
  mutate(source = factor(.data$source, levels = source_order))
```

## Inputs

```{r simulation-scope}
tibble(
  artifact = c("censoring models", "OU simulation"),
  created_at = c(as.character(censoring_artifact$created_at), as.character(simulation$created_at))
) |>
  knitr::kable()

simulation$fits |>
  select(ploidy, Gemcitabine, tau, velocity_scale, obs_noise, log_likelihood, fit_status) |>
  arrange(ploidy, Gemcitabine) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r censoring-model-comparison}
censoring_artifact$model_comparison |>
  mutate(model = factor(.data$model, levels = c("context", "full"))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(delta_aic, log_likelihood_gain),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = recode(
      .data$metric,
      delta_aic = "Delta AIC",
      log_likelihood_gain = "Log-likelihood gain vs context model"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = value, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) +
  facet_wrap(vars(metric), scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Context model: speed, distance to edge, nearest-object distance, confluency, frame/time, and a well random intercept. Full model adds ploidy, gemcitabine, speed interactions, and ploidy:gemcitabine."
  )
```

## MSD

```{r msd-comparison}
msd |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lag_frames, y = mean_squared_displacement_px2, color = source)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  facet_grid(dose_label ~ ploidy, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = source_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Lag (frames)",
    y = "Mean squared displacement (px^2)",
    color = NULL
  )
```

## Velocity Autocorrelation

```{r velocity-autocorrelation-comparison}
velocity_autocorrelation |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lag_frames, y = mean_cosine_autocorrelation, color = source)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  facet_grid(dose_label ~ ploidy) +
  scale_color_manual(values = source_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Lag (frames)",
    y = "Mean velocity cosine autocorrelation",
    color = NULL
  )
```

## Track Length

```{r track-length-comparison}
track_lengths |>
  ggplot(aes(x = track_length, fill = source, color = source)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(dose_label ~ ploidy, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = source_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = source_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Track length (frames)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  )
```

## Speed

```{r speed-comparison}
speeds |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed_capped, fill = source, color = source)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.16, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(dose_label ~ ploidy, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = source_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = source_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Speed, capped at the comparison-set 99th percentile (px/frame)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  )
```

```{r track-counts}
tracks |>
  group_by(.data$source, .data$ploidy, .data$Gemcitabine, .data$dose_label) |>
  summarize(
    n_tracks = n_distinct(.data$migration_track_id),
    n_points = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(.data$dose_label, .data$ploidy, .data$source) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
